name: SIRUS
description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for automated stock/crypto trading. Users connect brokers (Alpaca/KuCoin), pick strategies, backtest, then auto-trade with built-in risk controls. Firebase auth, FastAPI backend, real-time dashboard. Scales to thousands of users with production-grade security.

paragraphs: High-throughput systematic quantitative trading SaaS with sub-100ms Redis Streams execution, vectorized backtesting studio, and bank-grade AES-256 Demat key vault.

SIRUS is an institutional-grade, multi-tenant quantitative trading platform and algorithmic backtesting engine built for systematic hedge funds, proprietary desks, and quantitative traders. Traditional retail setups rely on brittle webhook bots or monolithic desktop programs that lack pre-trade risk controls, multi-broker connectivity, and hardware-grade credential security. SIRUS unifies equities Direct Market Access (Zerodha Kite Connect, Alpaca Markets, Interactive Brokers, Upstox, AngelOne) and cryptocurrency derivatives (KuCoin, Binance) into a single asynchronous event-driven…
